0.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_ROOM00016_000_000
0.description: Greetings, my <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403>, and may I offer you my warmest congratulations! My duty is to see that everything is precisely as you desire. If there is aught you wish to know, I am wholly at your disposal.

1.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_Q1_000_021
1.description: What would you like to know about?

2.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_A1_000_021
2.description: What I need to do here.

7.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_ROOM00016_000_040
7.description: Before you do aught else, may I suggest attiring yourself for the ceremony? This is the last opportunity to do so before you appear before the guests.

8.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_041
8.description: Please be warned that certain equipment for the hands will cause the ring to be hidden from sight.

9.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_042
9.description: Once you are attired to your liking, examine the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>registry<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> upon the table and select confirm.

10.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_043
10.description: You will be prompted to finalize the ceremony plan with your partner. Your selections must match before you may proceed.

11.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_044
11.description: This process must be completed within 20 minutes (Earth time) of doors opening. Failing to do so will result in the ceremony's cancellation.

12.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_045
12.description: Once you and your partner have agreed upon a ceremony plan, the guests will be ushered to the ceremony hall.

13.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_046
13.description: The ceremony will automatically commence 20 minutes (Earth time) from this point.

14.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_047
14.description: If you do not wish to wait, however, you may begin immediately by ringing the eternity bell.

15.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_ROOM00016_000_060
15.description: I should be glad to explain to you the uses of the eternity bell.

16.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_061
16.description: The eternity bell is an item that you and your partner may use to advance the proceedings.

17.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_062
17.description: Ordinarily, the ceremony will proceed through its stages at a predetermined pace.

18.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_063
18.description: If both you and your partner ring the eternity bell, however, you may move to the next stage without waiting.

19.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_064
19.description: The bell may first be used to signal the commencement of the ceremony itself.

20.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_065
20.description: Before ringing the bell, however, please communicate with both your partner and guests to ensure that they are ready to proceed.

21.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_100_065
21.description: The bell may be rung by using it in the Key Items menu. You may find it convenient to add it to your hotbar.

22.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_066
22.description: As a final note, once the ceremony is in motion, both you and your partner must ring the bell for it to have effect.

23.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_ROOM00016_000_080
23.description: If circumstance compels you to leave the venue, please be aware of the following particulars.

24.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_081
24.description: Prior to the ceremony's commencement, it is possible to leave the venue via the door or by simply logging out.

25.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_082
25.description: Please be warned, however, that the ceremony will be postponed if you are not present when it begins. You will be required to reschedule, and, for a period of time, under more disadvantageous conditions.

26.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_083
26.description: Likewise, it is possible to leave the venue mid-ceremony. However, completing the quest requires that both partners be present for the entire duration of the ceremony. Please take care not to log out by accident.

28.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_091
28.description: Your guests await the ceremony in a separate room, and are moved to the ceremony hall when you and your partner have finalized the ceremony plan.

29.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_092
29.description: Those who arrive late will be shown directly to the hall.

30.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_093
30.description: The ceremony will automatically commence 20 minutes (Earth time) from the time the ceremony plan is finalized. If you do not wish to wait, however, you may begin immediately by ringing the eternity bell.

31.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_094
31.description: Your attire at the time of the ceremony's commencement will be reflected in the ceremony's opening cutscene. Please ensure that your appearance is as you desire beforehand.

32.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_100_095
32.description: The ceremony will proceed as follows:

33.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_095
33.description: Firstly, you and your partner will make your entrance and say your vows. This is followed by the blessing and exchange of rings. Last comes the reception, during which you may mingle with guests.

34.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_096
34.description: In the case that no guests were invited, the reception will be a private time between you and your partner.

35.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_097
35.description: The ceremony will require approximately one and a half hours (Earth time) from start to finish, after which you may report to Claribel to complete the special quest “The Ties that Bind” and receive the rewards.

36.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_098
36.description: Upon the ceremony's conclusion, your guests will receive gifts in exchange for their invitations. Please remind them to hold on to their invitations until such time as the exchange has been made.

37.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYGUIDEROOM_00016_SYSTEM_000_500
37.description: If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to ask.
